subject: Recording release and SME slot confirmation — 'Inference at Scale' webinar

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodai.com>

Subject: Recording release and SME slot confirmation — 'Inference at Scale' webinar

Hi Lena —

Thanks again for agreeing to be a guest speaker on our Feb 28 webinar, "Inference at Scale: cost, latency, and rollout strategies." A few quick items so we can lock everything in: 

1) Recording + use rights: attached is our standard speaker release (speaker_release_v2.pdf). Can you review and confirm if you’re comfortable with the language? If you need a narrow promo-only clause instead of our standard perpetual media license, let me know — happy to surface to legal.

2) Run-of-show: draft attached (run_of_show_draft.docx). We have you at: 10:05–10:30 PT for a 20-minute segment (20 min talk + 10 min panel Q&A shared with our SME). We can shrink or split the Q&A based on your preference.

3) Prep call: can you do a 15–20 minute tech & content run-through the week before? Options: Feb 24 10:00 PT / Feb 25 11:00 PT / Feb 26 09:30 PT. Reply with your preferred slot and we’ll calendar it.

4) Bio & headshot: if you want a specific version used, please attach.

Attachments: speaker_release_v2.pdf, run_of_show_draft.docx

If you’d like Karthik or Marissa on the prep call (Karthik will demo a quick integration, Marissa is handling panel logistics), I’ve cc’d them.

Thanks — grateful to have you join us.

— Kimberly Park
Field Marketing Manager | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwoodai.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

From: Dr. Lena Morales <lena@arcadia-analytics.com>

Subject: Re: Recording release and SME slot confirmation — 'Inference at Scale' webinar

Hi Kimberly —

Really excited to participate. Quick responses below: 

• Release: I reviewed speaker_release_v2.pdf. One small ask — Section 3.2 currently reads a perpetual, worldwide license. For our counsel I need that narrowed to "promotion and education use by Redwood for a period of 3 years from broadcast." I attached a short redline PDF with the suggested language. Happy to sign once that revision is confirmed.

• Run-of-show: 20 minutes sounds great; can we reduce the public Q&A to 10 minutes so I have time for a focused demo of our plugin? Alternatively we can split: 12 mins talk + 8 mins demo for my portion, then 10 mins live Q&A with the panel. Your call.

• Prep call: Feb 24 at 10:00 PT works best for me.

• Bio & headshot: attached (lena_morales_bio.pdf, lena_headshot.jpg).

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Best,
Dr. Lena Morales
Chief Data Scientist, Arcadia Analytics
lena@arcadia-analytics.com

Kimberly / team —

Thanks — a couple operational notes from the engineering side: 

• On the run-of-show, I'd like the internal SME (me) to do a 5-minute lightning demo immediately after Lena's talk to show a quick integration snippet and then hand back to the panel for Q&A. That keeps momentum and avoids duplicative demo time. I've attached an edited run-of-show (updated_run_of_show_v3.docx) with timing adjustments.

• Lena's request to shorten public Q&A to 10 minutes is fine with me; we'll route deep technical questions to a post-webinar follow-up doc and offer a short live poll to triage.

• EventsPro: can you confirm we have a stage recording slot and a producer assigned? We need: one presenter feed for Lena (slides + webcam), one screen-share for Karthik's demo (low-latency), and an RTMP recording capture for post-production.

Action items: 
- Kimberly: finalize recording release language with legal and share updated doc for signature.
- EventsPro: confirm producer + tech checklist (camera feed, RTMP credentials).
- Marissa / Lauren: finalize attendee invite copy and add Lena's bio to the landing page.

Thanks — Karthik

All —

Great progress, thanks. Quick recap and next steps so everything is explicit:

Quoted from Lena's note for the redline: 
> "Section 3.2: change from 'perpetual, worldwide' to 'promotion and education use by Redwood for a period of 3 years from broadcast.'"

3) Prep call: confirmed Feb 24, 10:00 PT (calendar invite sent). Please prepare slides and any short demo credentials to test during the call.

4) Tech & recording: EventsPro — please confirm producer assignment and RTMP credentials by EOD Feb 16. Karthik, cc'd, will need a test window the morning of Feb 27 for screen-share performance.

5) Marketing assets: Marissa / Lauren — please update the landing page with Lena's bio (attached) and use lena_headshot.jpg. Copy should emphasize Arcadia's integration with Redwood.

Links / attachments:
